title: Composition of Simon local representations
statement: Let n, k, N ∈ ℕ, M, S ⊆ ℝᴺ with S ⊆ M, (V, W, ψ) a C¹ Simon local representation of M with ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ (IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ), V₁ ⊆ V, and (D, V₁, l) a C¹ Simon local representation of ψ⁻¹(S) with l : ℝᵏ → ℝⁿ (IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 (ψ⁻¹(S)) D V₁ l). Then there is W₁ ⊆ W with ψ(V₁) = W₁ ∩ M such that (D, W₁, ψ ∘ l) is a C¹ Simon local representation of S (IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 S D W₁ (ψ ∘ l), in particular W₁ is open).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k N : ℕ) (M S : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (D : Set (Rn k)) (V₁ : Set (Rn n)) (l : Rn k → Rn n), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → S ⊆ M → V₁ ⊆ V → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 (ψ ⁻¹' S) D V₁ l → ∃ W₁ : Set (Rn N), W₁ ⊆ W ∧ ψ '' V₁ = W₁ ∩ M ∧ Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 S D W₁ (ψ ∘ l)
